facts.value: Labour economics seeks to understand the functioning and dynamics of the markets for wage labour.
Labour markets function through the interaction of workers and employers.
Labour economics examines the supply of labour services (workers), the demand for labour services (employers), and the resulting patterns of wages, employment, and income.
In economics, labour is a measure of the work done by human beings.
Labour is conventionally contrasted with such other factors of production as land and capital.
